versions.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.
Switch the login instructions to the device flow (maton login prints a link and a user code; the --oauth flag is gone) and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.3.5.
Pin the Maton CLI install to 0.3.4, the current release.

Add this skill's own trigger policy to the shared Triggers section: the only destination it sets up is its own hosted function inside the platform, it does not forward events to third-party hosts, and it does not use event watch --exec; each trigger reference now also says this skill configures no trigger from that source on its own.

Bring the skill to the current api-gateway baseline and tell the connection-to-function-to-trigger story: the shared Functions and Triggers sections open with an example for this app (a hosted function that performs one action for it through the Maton SDK, and the trigger that runs it - its own event source where it has one, otherwise a time schedule), the description says these constructs turn the connection into automation and add no capability of their own, the passthrough is described by its enforced boundary, CLI and SDK installs are pinned to 0.3.1, absolute API URLs are placeholders, and multipart uploads use mktemp.

Stop the file contradicting itself about HTTP methods. Monday.com is a single GraphQL endpoint, so every call is a POST with a query body - the appendix no longer offers bodyless reads or PUT/DELETE, and confirmation now keys on the GraphQL operation (a query reads, a mutation writes) rather than the verb. Declares the me and users queries, and replaces the generic high-impact list with Monday's own: board and column deletes, structure changes, notifications, sharing, and webhooks.
CLI-first rewrite with the Maton SDK examples; clarify that the CLI and SDKs keep separate credential stores, and reword webhook egress warnings

CLI-first rewrite: the maton CLI with OAuth login is the documented path, every example is a maton command, SDK examples added, and the raw HTTP fallback feeds the key on stdin instead of reading it from the environment

- Changed all Maton endpoint URLs from gateway.maton.ai and ctrl.maton.ai to api.maton.ai for consistency and clarity.
- Updated usage examples and instructions to reflect new API endpoint.
- Connection management documentation revised to use unified endpoint.
- Added a Security & Permissions section highlighting explicit user approval for write operations.
- Removed the LICENSE.txt file from the repository.

- Added new metadata fields under the "metadata" section, including a "clawdbot" section with emoji and required environment variable information.
- No other changes to the skill implementation or usage instructions.

- Documentation formatting and content were updated in SKILL.md.
- No changes to code, logic, or API functionality were made.
- Improved clarity and completeness of the documentation for users.

No user-visible changes in this release.

- Version bumped with no SKILL.md or code changes detected.
- No new features, bug fixes, or documentation updates.

Initial release of Monday.com API skill with managed OAuth.

- Integrates Monday.com GraphQL API via Maton gateway.
- Supports managing boards, items, columns, groups, users, and workspaces.
- Provides connection management for Monday.com OAuth via Maton control interface.
- Requires a Maton API key and network access.
- Includes example code for authentication, queries, mutations, and connection management.
- Allows header-based selection of OAuth connection for multi-account support.
